use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture if a correlation is not found.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an action taken by the C² JU to maintain or update its surveillance data (database/picture), which aligns with the objective of defining reference points and geometric areas for tracking.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point, J3.1 Emergency Point, and the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track messages are used to report points, e.g., waypoints, downed aircraft, SAM sites, etc.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly defines the high-level objective of the use case: using specific message types to report geographic points.

evidence_cards.content: The goal is to define reference points and geometric areas (specifically segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses) by transmitting data reports with specific field values and indicators.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These paragraphs describe the objective of defining geometric entities through structured message fields and transmission rules, which constitutes the high-level goal of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission when reporting on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific objective/action of the primary actor (C2 JU) related to handling and processing target data for reporting, which aligns with the high-level goal of defining reference points/geometric areas in the context of track management.

evidence_cards.content: Each C2 JU has the responsibility to determine whether the data points being detected by its local sensors are currently reported on the interface and if there are any conflicts between locally derived information and information reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the high-level objective (goal) of the primary actor (C2 JU), which is to monitor and reconcile local sensor data with interface-reported data.

evidence_cards.content: The primary actor (C2 JU or JU) aims to report an Area of Probability (AOP), which is defined as that area in which there is a 95% probability (2 sigma) of a particular emitter being located.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement defines the specific objective (reporting an AOP with a defined confidence level) for the C2 JU within the context of defining reference points and geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.

source_locations.location: paragraph under section 4.4.3.1.2 LINES AND AREAS

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the high-level objective of the use case: to enable the C2 JU actor to define geometric areas and reference points via structured messages.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to define reference points and geometric areas, specifically including squares, rectangles, circles, ellipses, corridors, low level transit routes (LLTR), and slaved points/areas.

source_locations.location: Page 16 paragraph b ('Square, Rectangle, Circles and Ellipse Definition') and Page 17 paragraph c ('Corridor and Low Level Transit Route...') and section 4.4.3.1.3 ('SLAVED POINTS AND AREAS').
Page 16 paragraph b ('Square, Rectangle, Circles and Ellipse Definition') and Page 17 paragraph c ('Corridor and Low Level Transit Route...') and section 4.4.3.1.3 ('SLAVED POINTS AND AREAS').

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These sections explicitly describe the types of entities (reference points and geometric areas) that are being defined in this use case, directly fulfilling the 'goal' slot.

evidence_cards.content: The JU may purge remote reference points, lines, and areas and land (ground) points if they are no longer required.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific objective related to the management of reference points that the C2 JU performs within the context of defining or maintaining them, fulfilling the 'goal' slot for this aspect of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission when reporting on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific objective/action for the C2 JU related to track data processing and reporting, which contributes to the high-level goal of defining reference points and geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the high-level objective (goal) of the primary actor (C2 JU) in the context of defining geometric areas (AOPs).

evidence_cards.content: The primary objective of the use case is to define reference points and geometric areas for transmission within the tactical data link system.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1.4 (NONSLAVED MOVING POINTS, LINES, AND AREAS) and Section 4.4.3.2 (REPORTING RESPONSIBILITY FOR POINTS, LINES, AND AREAS)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These sections describe the rules and responsibilities for reporting and maintaining reference points, lines, and areas, which aligns with the goal of defining such entities.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point message is used to report the actual or expected Impact Point of a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This directly states the objective of the use case from the perspective of the system (C² JU) — reporting impact points via reference point messages — which aligns with the 'goal' slot for defining reference points and geometric areas in context of ballistic missile tracking.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the objective (reporting an Area of Probability) that the primary actor (C2 JU) performs in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R^2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim defines the specific objective (goal) of the C2 JU in this use case: responding to a ballistic missile data update request with a space track message.

evidence_cards.content: Certain reference points and areas may be slaved in a constant position in relation to a Related TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific system state condition (the existence of a 'Related TN') required before a point or area can be defined as 'slaved'.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a precondition where a JU must request data if it lacks reporting responsibility (R²) and needs immediate transmission of a point/line/area before defining its own reference points or areas.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that C2 JUs must be configured to participate in J3 Surveillance message exchange and transmit via Network PGs — a necessary system state before defining reference points or geometric areas using those messages.

evidence_cards.content: The Exercise Indicator in the J3.0 message is only used to amplify J3.0 messages with the Point Type field set to value 6, Area (Hazard), and the Point Amplification field set to value 3, Allied Missile Engagement Zone (MEZ), or value 4, Hostile MEZ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a precondition that specific field values must be set before the Exercise Indicator can be meaningfully applied in a reference point message.

evidence_cards.content: For all other values of the Point Type and Point Amplification fields in the J3.0 message the Exercise Indicator field shall be set to value 0.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.10, last sentence of second paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory default state for the Exercise Indicator field unless specific preconditions are met, which constrains system behavior prior to transmission.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a mandatory constraint on the system state (positional accuracy comparison) that must hold before the C² JU can transmit a track report with a specific TQ value; it acts as a precondition for valid reporting.

evidence_cards.content: When reported on the Surveillance NPG by a C² JU, a TQ value as specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to a track not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific initial condition (track source and acquisition status) required for assigning TQ values during surveillance reporting, serving as a precondition for the assignment logic.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the required system state (active originator retaining R²) that must hold before the use case can proceed with reporting or updating launch points.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must be capable of generating and managing track numbers.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a prerequisite capability for the C2 JU to determine which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, which is necessary before defining reference points or geometric areas via data reports.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes that the system must be capable of generating and maintaining track numbers before it can define and report an Area of Probability (AOP), which is one type of geometric area in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: An AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs. An AOP resulting from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This implies that prior existence of LOB or fix reports with existing TNs is a precondition for creating an AOP derived from them — and that such derivation requires assignment of a new TN, indicating state dependency.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU is ready to transmit a data report defining a reference point or geometric area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the minimal entry context for the use case: the system must be prepared to send a J3.0 message with appropriate field values (e.g., Point Type, Slaved Indicator) as described in the region.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have reporting responsibility for the specific point, line, or area before it can cease reporting or transmit a termination message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the necessary system state (possession of reporting responsibility) required for the actor to perform actions related to terminating or managing defined points/areas, which is a key precondition for the lifecycle management of these entities.

evidence_cards.content: For segmented lines or multisided areas defined by more than one Reference TN, time and Time Function shall be reported for the first Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory data requirement (time association) that must be satisfied when defining complex geometric areas, acting as a precondition for the valid transmission of such definitions.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must possess R² (Responsibility) for the specific reference point, line, or area to initiate a force tell alert on it.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that having R² is a mandatory system state condition before the actor can perform the initiation of an alert, which is part of defining the status of the reference point/area.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency alerts are not used on reference points, lines, or areas.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on the types of alerts applicable to this use case, implying the precondition that emergency alert indicators cannot be set for these entities.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J3.5 message on the IU using the assigned address of the inactive IU when required for tactical situation reporting.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a triggering event (tactical situation reporting requirement) that initiates transmission of a specific message type by the C2 JU, which aligns with defining reference points or geometric areas via data reports as part of surveillance messaging.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU initiates a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific user action (setting the FT IND) that triggers the initiation of an alert within the context of defining reference points and areas.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when the C2 JU transmits a Request Indicator message with the 'REFERENCE POINT' category set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific initiating event (transmission of a request for Reference Point data) that starts the interaction sequence described in the document.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an event — a JU desiring immediate transmission — that triggers a specific action (transmitting a J7.1 message), which qualifies as a trigger for initiating data reporting behavior related to defining points/areas.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for defining a Ballistic Missile Launch Point is the need to report the actual or expected launch point of a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific event (reporting a launch point) that initiates the use case for this variant.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for defining a Ballistic Missile Impact Point is the need to report the actual or expected impact point of a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific event (reporting an impact point) that initiates the use case for this variant.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU initiates the definition of an Area of Probability (AOP) when it generates and maintains track numbers based on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of these.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This identifies the specific event (generation/maintenance of track numbers with supporting data basis) that triggers the reporting action for AOPs within the use case scope.

evidence_cards.content: The use case for 'Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas' is triggered when the C2 JU transmits a data report (such as J3.0) containing specific field values and indicators to define a selected reference point or geometric area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section describes the response to a request (J7.1), implying that the initial definition of areas/points occurs via transmission of reports like J3.0 or J3.7, which constitutes the trigger event for defining these entities.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for the use case is whenever a TN pair is determined to be a dual designation by the recognizing JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly states the event that initiates the transmission of the J7.2 message, which defines reference points and geometric areas in this context.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point messages are used to report points (e.g., waypoints) and provide the capability to transmit lines such as FEBAs and roads, areas such as search areas, and volumes such as corridors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the functional scope of the J3.0 message for defining reference points and geometric areas, which serves as the basis for the C2 JU's transmission action in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.3.1.2 LINES AND AREAS, first paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This section defines the scope and capabilities of the J3.0 message which is the mechanism used by the C2 JU to define geometric areas, implying the trigger involves initiating this specific message type.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) original message to initiate the definition of reference points and geometric areas.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific action (transmitting an original J3.0/J3.5 message) that serves as the trigger for defining reference points and geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a response trigger (receipt of J7.1 request) rather than the initial trigger for defining reference points; it does not support the use case where C2 JU transmits J3.0 to define reference points as the starting action.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the C2 JU transmits a single J3.0 message using a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C1 word sequence; if the line is moving, a J3.0C2 word is added to the first message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary action and message structure for creating simple segmented lines in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the Line/Area Continuation Indicator is set to No Statement in the initial word, the End Point field is set to value 1 (End Point), and the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field is set to value 2 (Line).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required field values for the system to correctly interpret the data as a complete segmented line.

evidence_cards.content: To define segmented lines or multisided areas with more than 3 points, multiple J3.0 messages are transmitted, each with a unique TN; subsequent messages have the Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 1, and the last point of the previous message must match the first point of the current message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the interaction sequence for complex geometries requiring message chaining.

evidence_cards.content: When describing a multisided area with more than 3 points, the last point location transmitted must be the same as the initial point location to close the figure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the geometric constraint required to successfully define a closed area.

evidence_cards.content: To define a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the C2 JU uses a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2, J3.5I/J3.5E0/J3.5C3, or J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence, setting the Point/Line/Area Descriptor to value 1 (Single Point Area) and using the Square/Circle Switch to distinguish shape types.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific message sequences and field settings for standard geometric shapes.

evidence_cards.content: Corridors are reported using Point Type value 4 and Point Amplification value 3, while Low Level Transit Routes (LLTRs) use Point Type value 4 and Point Amplification value 6, with width reported in the Area Major Axis field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific parameter values for reporting corridor and transit route areas.

evidence_cards.content: To define a slaved point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude/Longitude from a Related TN when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1; if the J3.0E0 word is included, Latitude and Longitude fields are set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the procedure for defining relative positions tied to another track number.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line or multisided area, the C2 JU transmits data reports where any change to a point comprising the entity causes the entire line or area to be re-transmitted; receiving units purge previous data and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the transmission interaction sequence for updating segmented lines and multisided areas.

evidence_cards.content: The TNs used to initiate the segmented line or multisided area shall be transmitted for every report of that entity, including changes to R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory field inclusion step in the main flow for these entities.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 is used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the identification protocol required during the definition process.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the C2 JU uses a specific word sequence (e.g., J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2) and sets the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field to value 1 (Single Point Area).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the initial setup steps for geometric shapes.

evidence_cards.content: Corridors are reported using Point Type value 4 and Point Amplification value 3; Low Level Transit Routes (LLTR) use Point Type value 4 and Point Amplification value 6.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific parameter settings required to report these linear areas.

evidence_cards.content: For slaved points or areas, the position is established as Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the calculation and reporting step for slaved entities.

evidence_cards.content: Moving points, lines, and areas are reported by setting Course and Speed in the J3.0C2 word to values other than No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the action required to report non-slaved moving entities.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific action required to initiate an alert as part of the main flow for defining reference points and areas.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert and setting the FT IND in subsequent J3.0 messages to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the termination step for alerts associated with reference points/areas.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for the point, line, or area, it shall transmit the appropriate FT IND value as previously received in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the hand-off procedure within the interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate a force tell alert by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the initiation/termination actions for a JU without R² authority.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a segmented line or multisided area by transmitting the FT IND set to value 1 in all J3.0 messages used to report the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the initiation process for complex geometric entities like segmented lines.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their databases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms the system response/reception step for alerts on tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a canonical success scenario where the C2 JU responds to a data update request by transmitting a specific message (J3.6) in response to a trigger (J7.1 with ACT=2), which constitutes a main flow step for handling ballistic missile data updates.

evidence_cards.content: The JU shall transmit the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the action the system (JU) performs as part of the main flow: transmitting data in a defined message format (J3.6 word sequence) after receiving a valid request.

evidence_cards.content: For defining reference points and geometric areas via J3.0 messages: the reporting JU assigns a TN(s) to each point/line/area; position is reported using geodetic latitude/longitude values; altitude/elevation may be included if required; time associated with the entity is reported in hours/minutes as defined by the Time Function field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the canonical sequence of data fields and actions the C2 JU performs when transmitting a J3.0 message to define a reference point or geometric area — directly constitutes the main flow steps for this use case.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message supports transmission of lines (e.g., FEBAs, roads), areas (e.g., search areas, exercise areas), and volumes (e.g., corridors) in addition to points.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms that the main flow includes defining not only points but also linear, areal, and volumetric geometries via J3.0 — aligns with goal scope and expands main flow applicability.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line or multisided area, the reporting JU shall transmit the entire line or area when any change occurs to data concerning any point comprising a portion of it; receiving units shall purge the previously held segment and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific interaction step for modifying existing geometric areas in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The TNs used to initiate the segmented line or multisided area shall be transmitted for every report of the segmented line or multisided area, including a change of R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory field transmission requirement for every report in the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the rule for identifier usage throughout the lifecycle of the defined area in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the initial word shall be set to value 2 (Line) when describing a segmented line and value 3 (Multi-point Area) when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides the specific configuration steps required to define these geometric types in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, a J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2, J3.5I/J3.5E0/J3.5C3, or J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence is used.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific message sequences used to define standard geometric shapes in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: To describe a single point area, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the field setting required for the 'Single Point Area' definition step.

evidence_cards.content: The Square/Circle Switch field indicates that either a square or rectangle is being described when set to value 1, or indicates either a circle or ellipse is being described when set to value 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the conditional logic for selecting shape types within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A square or circle is being described when the Area Major Axis and Area Minor Axis fields are equal; when the axes are not equal, a rectangle or ellipse is described depending on the value of the Square/Circle Switch.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Explains the system's interpretation logic based on field values during the definition process.

evidence_cards.content: For an Area of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12, the AOP shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific constraint on the main flow for defining an AOP: it must be transmitted as a non-slaved entity when using the specified point type and amplification values.

evidence_cards.content: To relate or associate an ASW AOP to a track or point (e.g., a subsurface track for which contact has been lost), a J7.7 Association message may be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an optional association step that can follow the definition of an AOP, indicating how the defined area is linked to other entities — part of the extended main flow for operational use.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an Area of Probability (AOP) based on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of these.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the basis for initiating AOP reporting, which is the start of the main flow for defining an AOP.

evidence_cards.content: An AOP is reported using a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum, with the J3.7I word transmitted with FIX BRG field set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact message structure and field settings required to transmit the AOP definition.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.7I word contains the time the AOP was valid and the J3.7C2 word defines the AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific content fields within the message that carry the temporal and spatial definition of the area.

evidence_cards.content: If an AOP results from previously reported LOBs, it shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs; however, if a fix is changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix shall be used.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the logic for Track Number (TN) assignment during the creation of the AOP, distinguishing between derivation from LOBs versus conversion from a fix.

evidence_cards.content: The main flow for defining an Area of Probability (AOP) involves the C2 JU transmitting a data report to define the entity. If the AOP is formed from a single fix, the system retains the same Track Number (TN). If the AOP is formed from 2 or more fixes, the system assigns a new TN.

source_locations.location: Table 4.7-1 (row 'EW FIX', column 'EW AOP') and Note 2

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This provides the specific step-by-step logic (canonical success scenario) for the 'main_flow' slot regarding the definition of an Area of Probability, specifically addressing the condition for track number continuity.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the C2 JU uses a single J3.0 message where the Line/Area Continuation Indicator is set to No Statement, the End Point field is set to value 1 (End Point), and the Point/Line/Area Descriptor is set to value 2 (Line).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific interaction sequence for creating simple segmented lines.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line or multisided area with more than 3 points, the C2 JU transmits multiple J3.0 messages. The second and all subsequent messages must have the Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 1 (Line/Area Continuation).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the interaction sequence for complex shapes requiring multiple messages.

evidence_cards.content: When joining three or more points to form a segmented line, the segments are connected in sequence: the first segment is drawn from the point in the J3.0E0 word to the point established by Delta Latitude/Longitude 1 fields in the J3.0C1 word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the geometric construction logic applied during the data report transmission.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific handling rule for AOPs within the main flow of defining geometric areas, indicating they are an exception to slaving rules.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Indicates that motion status (moving vs static) is a state attribute included in the definition.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a change to data concerning any point comprising a portion of a segmented line or multisided area, receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state update (purge and replace) that occurs upon successful transmission of an updated geometric area definition.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistent identifier association (postcondition) that results from successfully initiating the definition of a segmented entity.

evidence_cards.content: For a slaved reference point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1, establishing a constant true or relative bearing and range.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting system state (constant positional relationship) for slaved entities after the defining report is processed.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains reporting responsibility (R²) as long as the originator remains active and reports the entity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate postcondition state regarding ownership and responsibility after successful transmission of a reference point/area definition.

evidence_cards.content: Reporting responsibility (R²) transfers to another JU only upon operator action if the original unit becomes inactive (via J7.0 message) or fails to update for three consecutive intervals.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies that the default postcondition is retention of R² by the originator; transfer is an exception requiring specific failure conditions.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the C2 JU shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the post-use-case state for a C2 JU after receiving a data update request regarding its own track number: it has reported its engagement and platform/system status, which constitutes an observable system state change following successful completion of the interaction.

evidence_cards.content: The system retains the Track Number (TN) and last reported position of a fixed land (ground) IU that has reverted to an inactive status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-transmission state for fixed ground units that become inactive, satisfying the postconditions slot requirement.

evidence_cards.content: When a fixed land (ground) IU reverts to inactive status but is required for tactical situation reporting, the JU shall transmit a J3.5 message on the IU using the assigned address of the inactive IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the operational behavior following the retention of an inactive IU's data, confirming the system state allows for reactivation via specific messaging.

evidence_cards.content: When a segmented line or multisided area is defined and data concerning any point comprising a portion of the entity changes, receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state update mechanism for receiving units upon successful transmission of updated geometric data, constituting a postcondition of the definition/update use case.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistent identity state of the defined entity in the system after successful creation.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 or J3.5 (PTI = 0) point, line, or area retains reporting responsibility (R²) as long as the originator remains active and reports the entity.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-transmission state where the C2 JU maintains reporting responsibility for the defined reference points or geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may assume R² for the point, line, or area using the same Reference TN(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the conditions under which the system state changes regarding reporting responsibility after the initial definition.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a point, line, or area for which it had reporting responsibility, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the action required to terminate the reporting state established by the use case.

evidence_cards.content: There is no requirement to continue transmitting a missile impact point after predicted impact.

source_locations.location: paragraph under section 4.4.6.4 BALLISTIC MISSILE IMPACT POINT REPORTING

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the termination condition for post-transmission state of ballistic missile impact point reporting — directly relevant to postconditions as it specifies when transmission ceases after successful definition and prediction.

evidence_cards.content: A change in R² of the ballistic missile track also causes a change in R² for the related Impact Point.

source_locations.location: paragraph under section 4.4.6.4 BALLISTIC MISSILE IMPACT POINT REPORTING

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a system state dependency that persists after successful transmission — relevant to postconditions as it defines how reference responsibility (R²) propagates between related entities after initial reporting.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line defined by multiple word sequences, the point location in each subsequent message is coincident with the last point described in the previous word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state constraint for multi-message geometric area definitions: continuity of position data across messages ensures the line is properly formed after transmission completes.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a multisided figure via segmented line messages, the end point (Point 4) must be coincident with Point 3 to close the figure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required final state condition for successfully closing a multisided area — the endpoint must match the prior vertex, ensuring geometric closure upon successful completion.
